Mod.Name: Chemical Suppliers
Mod.Author: NyanDoggo
Mod.Description: Two new sellers for the drug lab. The Chemical Merchant sells alcohol, reducing agent, pure N-Methylol Base for Phanta and cheap starch filler; call them from Extra Customer's F8 list. The Shady Mushroom Seller sells a big lot of Dream Caps and Nightmare Caps at a wholesale discount; they walk in on their own (20% of days by default, 0 to 100 in this mod's settings) and can also be called from Extra Customer.
